%doc: Source-of-truth manifest of the SMW properties Module:Entity emits as structured data (StructuredData.store -> mw.smw.set). Each Property: page is generated from this with [[Has type::<smw>]]. Bucket-forward: only PAGE/TEXT/INTEGER/DOUBLE/BOOLEAN are used (never Quantity); data is stored UNITLESS (units are a render concern). `bucket` records the intended Bucket field type for the future migration (SMW has no integer/double split). `modules` lists the emitting Entity module(s). Multi-valued props (Effects/Systems) are TEXT for now; revisit their modeling at Bucket time.

Acquisition kind.desc: Acquisition kind of a commodity record.

Ammo.desc: Magazine / ammunition capacity of a weapon.

Arm time.desc: Arming delay of a bomb, in seconds.

Available.desc: Whether a mission is currently available.

Base variant.desc: Whether an item is the canonical base piece (true) rather than a colorway or edition variant (false).
